honest_limitations.ring_discrepancy_explanation: 20 rings detected vs. 19 seeded — likely a case of two rings merging via a shared secondary mule account (ACC-MULE-004 was shared between RING-01 and RING-13). In production deployment, temporal decay weighting is required to prevent over-clustering.
honest_limitations.synthetic_data_boundary: Validation was executed against synthetic multi-hop topologies conforming to SIH standards. Real-world FIR reports often suffer from incomplete bank transaction statements, delayed reporting (>48h), and unindexed payment aggregator wallets.
honest_limitations.probabilistic_caution: Predictions represent likelihood indices based on historical cashout hubs and mule branch jurisdictions; they do NOT constitute judicial evidence or proof of guilt. On-ground verification by an investigating officer is strictly mandatory.
